_comment: Atlas Growth :: US residential standby-generator installers, nationwide (ICP-generators.md). Engine config for google-maps-scrape. Job-specific values live ONLY here. PROVISIONAL until the calibration call: the google_types allow/deny lists were written from the ICP, not yet from a live result set — re-check them against the first calibration tiles (Houston, Tampa, Hartford) before the full run.

scrape_tuning._r: Same settings as the UK and AU runs (measured 2.61 Maps calls per runsheet row over 1,770 rows). paginate:true pages each viewport via offset; max_pages 6 x limit 150 caps a dense metro; max_depth 1 = at most one quadrant split.

qualify_rules._r: 1. Must-drop PRIMARY types. Rental yards, big-box and parts counters answer 'generator' queries but install nothing for homeowners. Small-engine / lawn-equipment shops are the Briggs trap: deny only when it is the PRIMARY type, because a real installer can carry an incidental small-engine tag. Vehicle/marine/RV generator work is a different trade.
qualify_rules.label: off_icp_type

qualify_rules._r: 2. Must-drop by NAME (always fires, primary or secondary type).
qualify_rules.label: name_deny

qualify_rules._r: 3. Positive allow on google_types-ANY (never primary). Generator dealers on Maps are typed Generator shop, Electrician, Electrical installation service, HVAC contractor, Solar energy company or plain Contractor. Plumbing is allowed through on purpose: the plumber rule is decided at the site-text gate (STEP 5e), not here.
qualify_rules.label: not_in_icp

qualify_rules._r: 4. Size floor 30 (operator 2026-09-24, same as foundation repair). Consumer-facing trade, so reviews track size. Applies to Maps rows only; OEM dealer-list rows carry no reviews and are not floored.
qualify_rules.label: too_small

_no_website_rule: Deliberately NO {website, exists} rule, same as the foundation config: collapse-domains.js routes no-website rows to the STEP 5d recovery track after the denies have run.

brand_families._r: No generator roll-ups labelled yet. Add at GATE 3 once the calibration tiles show which multi-location brands appear (location_count flags them regardless).

owner_query._r: Same as the foundation run: the scraper.tech SERP endpoint is title-only, so the LinkedIn leg is the useful harvest. search-owner.js has no working backend; owner-finding runs on the in-session read + sweep rungs.
